coded_segments.text: Essential Safety Tips for Solo Female Travelers

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P012
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Safety is non-negotiable for any traveler, but it’s especially crucial for women exploring the world solo. Being proactive and informed can significantly reduce risks and empower you to enjoy your adventure with confidence. Here’s a breakdown of essential safety tips:

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P013
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Share your itinerary: Provide a detailed itinerary to a trusted friend or family member. Include flight details, accommodation addresses, planned activities, and expected check-in/check-out dates. If you deviate from your plan, inform them immediately.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P014
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Research your destination: Thoroughly research your destination’s safety profile. Are there specific areas to avoid? What are the common scams targeting tourists? Understanding local laws and customs is vital. Look up emergency contact numbers and the location of the nearest embassy or consulate.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P015
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Situational awareness is key: Be aware of your surroundings at all times. Trust your gut instinct. If a situation feels uncomfortable or unsafe, remove yourself immediately. Pay attention to local news and any safety advisories.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P016
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Stay in well-lit and populated areas: Avoid walking alone at night, especially in poorly lit or deserted areas. Stick to well-trafficked streets and public spaces. If you must walk at night, consider traveling with a group or using a reputable ride-hailing app.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P017
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Be selective about sharing information: Be cautious about who you talk to and what personal information you share. Avoid discussing your travel plans or revealing where you’re staying with strangers.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P018
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Secure your valuables: Use a money belt, hidden pouch, or secure travel wallet to keep your cash, cards, and passport safe. Avoid displaying expensive jewelry, electronics, or large amounts of cash.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P019
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Stay connected (but be smart): While it’s important to stay connected with friends and family, be mindful of what you share on social media. Avoid posting real-time updates about your location, as this can make you a target for unwanted attention.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P020
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Transportation safety: When using taxis or ride-hailing apps, especially at night, verify the driver’s identity and license plate. Share your ride details with a friend or family member. Be wary of unmarked taxis or drivers who approach you unsolicited.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P021
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Food & Accommodation safety: Choose reputable accommodations with good security measures. Be cautious about accepting drinks from strangers. Never leave your drink unattended, and don’t accept drinks from someone you don’t trust.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P022
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Asking for help: Remember that it’s okay to ask for help. If you need help, approach families, couples, or women traveling alone. They are generally more likely to offer genuine assistance. Avoid approaching lone men, especially in isolated areas.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P023
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Blending in (when appropriate): While you should never compromise your safety, try to blend in with the local culture and avoid drawing unnecessary attention to yourself. Dress modestly and respectfully, and observe local customs and traditions. Knowing a few basic phrases in the local language can be helpful in emergencies and shows respect for the local culture.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P024
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Trust your instincts: Your intuition is a powerful tool. If a situation feels off or makes you uncomfortable, trust your gut and remove yourself from the situation. Don’t hesitate to seek help from local authorities or other trusted individuals.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P025
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Safety Items for Solo Female Travelers

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P026
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Traveling alone as a woman requires careful planning, and a crucial aspect of that is prioritizing your safety. Apart from following all the safety tips for solo female travelers; carrying the right safety items can provide peace of mind and empower you to navigate unfamiliar situations with greater confidence. Here’s a look at some essential safety items for solo female travelers.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P027
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Personal Safety Alarm: This small, handheld device emits a piercingly loud siren (typically 120-130 decibels) when activated. The sudden noise can startle an attacker, disorient them, and attract attention. Test your alarm regularly to ensure it functions correctly. Some models include a built-in LED light, adding another layer of visibility.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P028
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Pepper Spray: A non-lethal self-defense spray containing an irritant that causes temporary burning and discomfort to the eyes, nose, and throat. It can incapacitate an attacker, giving you time to escape. Crucially, know how to use it. Seek self-defense training that includes pepper spray practice. Remember, it’s for self-defense only. Be aware of local laws regarding pepper spray, as it may be restricted or illegal in some areas. Less-lethal alternatives, such as bear spray (intended for bears but usable in extreme human encounters), may also be considered.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P029
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: LED Rechargeable Flashlight: A bright flashlight is a multi-purpose tool. It can illuminate dark areas, signal for help, and even be used defensively by shining it in an attacker’s eyes. A tactical flashlight with a strobe function is even more effective. The rapidly flashing light can disorient and temporarily blind an attacker, giving you time to escape. Rechargeable models are best for travel, so you don’t have to worry about running out of batteries.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P030
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Padlock or Luggage Lock: A good lock can deter opportunistic theft. TSA-approved locks are essential for air travel. These locks allow airport security to inspect your luggage without cutting the lock, preventing damage to your belongings. While a lock won’t stop a determined thief, it can make your luggage a less appealing target.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P031
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Fanny Pack/Cross-body Bag: Keeping your valuables close to your body is crucial for preventing pickpocketing. A money belt worn discreetly under clothing is the most secure option. A cross-body bag worn in front is also a good choice. Avoid traditional fanny packs worn around the waist, as they can be easily targeted by thieves.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P032
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Copies of Important Documents: Losing your passport or other important documents can be a nightmare. Make digital copies of your passport, visa, driver’s license, travel insurance, and other essential documents. Store these copies securely in the cloud (using a password-protected service) or on a password-protected USB drive. Also, leave a copy of your itinerary with a trusted friend or family member.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P033
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Emergency Contact Information: Have a list of emergency contact numbers readily accessible. This should include local police, the nearest embassy or consulate, your family members, and your travel insurance provider. Program ICE (In Case of Emergency) contacts into your phone. This allows first responders to quickly access your emergency contacts even if your phone is locked.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P034
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: First-Aid Kit: A small, well-stocked first-aid kit is essential for treating minor injuries and ailments. Include bandages, antiseptic wipes, pain relievers, any personal medications you need, and a small first-aid manual or app on your phone. Customize the kit to your specific needs. If you have allergies or medical conditions, make sure you have the necessary medications and supplies.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P035
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Portable Power Bank: Keeping your phone charged is critical, especially in an emergency. A portable power bank allows you to recharge your phone on the go. Choose a power bank with sufficient capacity to charge your phone multiple times.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P036
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Other Essentials For Solo Trips

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P037
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Whistle: A loud, high-pitched whistle can be used to attract attention in an emergency. It’s a simple but effective tool.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P038
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Travel Insurance: Travel insurance is absolutely essential. It can protect you from financial losses due to medical emergencies, lost luggage, trip cancellations, and other unforeseen events. Make sure you have adequate coverage for your trip.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P039
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Local Laws and Customs: Before you travel, research the local laws and customs of your destination. This is especially important regarding self-defense tools. What’s legal in one country may be illegal in another. Understanding local customs can also help you avoid misunderstandings and potentially dangerous situations.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P040
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Remember, these safety items are tools to help you stay safe. The most important safety measure is to be aware of your surroundings, trust your instincts, and make smart choices. Combine these tools with good judgment and proactive planning for a safer and more enjoyable travel experience.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P041
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Taking the plunge into solo female travel can be exhilarating, but it’s also understandable to feel a bit apprehensive at first. If the idea of navigating the world entirely on your own feels daunting, consider a fantastic alternative: all-girls trips. These curated group adventures allow you to experience the joys of travel without the initial jitters of going completely solo, the task of following all these safety tips for solo female travelers. Several companies now specialize in organizing these empowering getaways, catering specifically to women seeking adventure, connection, and personal growth.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P042
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: These all-girls trips aren’t just about sightseeing; they’re about fostering a sense of community and empowering women to step outside their comfort zones. The perks are numerous. First and foremost, there’s the built-in safety net of traveling with a group of like-minded women. Plus, the logistics are handled for you, taking the stress out of planning and allowing you to focus on enjoying the journey.

coded_segments.segment_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html_P043
coded_segments.source_id: A Beginner's Guide to Safety_ Solo Travel for Women _ Blog - JustWravel.html
coded_segments.doc_title: A Beginner's Guide to Safety: Solo Travel for Women
coded_segments.text: Solo female travel can be an incredible experience. It’s a chance to challenge yourself, discover new places, and grow as a person. With careful planning and a focus on safety, you can have an amazing and empowering adventure.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P001
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: Girls in India travelling alone? We mostly get weird looks and speculations around this question.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P002
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: So when my neighbor aunty heard it, I was given really bad expressions as if I was committing a crime along with suggestions that I should probably quit the plan...

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P003
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: The idea of a girl travelling (especially solo) is something of a foreign concept, she said. I did feel uncomfortable and immediately a war of thoughts began to emerge in my head. I wanted to say a lot aloud but I just sighed as I can’t change the age old mentality in one day.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P004
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: Although it was not something I had ever heard before. Hence, I was NOT astonished to hear that!!!

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P005
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: Being a female solo travel enthusiast in India and a part of both urban and rural societies, I do understand where these mindsets are coming from.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P006
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: There are cases in some rural societies where still Indian women are thought to be under home arrest their entire life after marriage. There are rare exceptions too but we still come across the issue of child marriage in many villages & cities. Trust me it is hard to advocate to allow girls to travel solo in a land where it’s still a challenge to persuade families for letting their girl-child to go to school.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P007
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: "Misogyny & Patriarchy run deep in our veins"

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P008
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: We also can’t deny the fact that India is not known as the safest place or a favorable destination for girls travelling solo thanks to innumerable crimes that are committed with women & girls all across the nation. Generally, men have the privilege to travel anywhere alone because they are not subject to issues like safety & security. Women are expected to be careful and avoid solo travelling.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P009
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: Even though in India we have many breathtaking destinations, it’s much more challenging for females and many are taking advantage of them. It is sad how the highest percentage of women are killed, betrayed or brutally cheated around the world. It has become hard on us to be able to trust anybody as we have been deceived by someone we knew, someone we trusted, someone we loved, someone we considered a friend or colleague.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P010
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: In a perfect India every girl/lady would be respected with her lifestyle choices and treated well but that is not the case yet.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P011
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: 8 problems solo female travellers face while travelling in India:

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P012
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: India is to provide secured solo travel for girls, said no one ever. There have been rapes and assaults in hotels, cars, boats and many other places. Security is everything for us. Girls always have to adjust their schedules based on the time of the day to ensure we avoid any late evening or mid-night travels. Definitely we can’t utilize our time effectively worrying about our safety. Most of the time, we have to opt for premium accommodations out of our budget just for security sake. So there is this "unofficial curfew time" which we are always expected to adhere to just because you are a solo lady traveller in India.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P013
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: We have to compromise on every aspect, be it hygienic public toilets, sanitary pads, or even accommodation. Girls travelling alone are often not welcomed, doubted and even slut shamed by the so called "society". Basic facilities as well as infrastructure is something females travelling alone must get. Proper female attendants to be present and working cameras should be installed for every female accommodation along with clean toiletries.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P014
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: No shorts. No tank tops. No off-shoulders etc. In some places if girls wear jeans - that's a problem too. Girls have to take care of their dressing while travelling in many places or else we are watched upon as a hunt. I really don’t want to get into the dispute that it's an issue of man’s perceptions of woman….because the reality is that when we are traveling, we do watch our dressing even if we want to wear whatever we like. The last time we checked it was legal to be wearing bikini on a beach in India but no India runs on moral policing which feels it is okay to pee in public but a girl can't wear what she wants.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P015
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: Girls too enjoy going out at nights to have a peaceful walk in the park, beach or even in a restaurant. Most girls avoid because they just can't risk their lives. We miss out the ecstasy of nightlife without having to worry about getting into any kind of trouble. Even if we go to restaurants we need to be very careful about someone trying to trick us with drinks or foods. Much news has been evident [Ex. Nirbhaya Case] that some awful men take advantage of girls who are doing night outs. We are forced to hold our love to explore the night by just looking outside from a window.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P016
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: Dear Men: The ladies you chase in clubs deserve the same respect as your mother or sister!!

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P018
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: We girls are alienated when it comes to solo traveling, be it our relatives or friends. Many people judge saying “Girls have brought their own problems by travelling alone, if something goes wrong, it’s their fault”. We cannot totally blame families as our society has been this way since ages. So, girls are opposed instead of getting open support. Thinking about our well-being, parents have their share of concerns. Many perceive us as bad girls or as if we just hook-up here and there.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P019
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: I often ask myself, how to minimize the staring and ogling by men? I am sure many girls take stoles [dupattas] even if they do not need it just to hide the shape of body parts in case its a body hugging dress, in a wrong notion that this will stop some rascals from leering at them. People everywhere, in public transports or on roads do make it a point to pass comments on girls' bodies especially when they are alone. We deal with it every day and even more while travelling solo. If we react to it they take it personally and bully us, if we ignore and be quite then they enjoy it.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P020
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: People, especially some men, become very friendly when there are girls alone. In some cultures, touching while talking may be a normal gesture but some men can take it in different ways. Girls even maintain a proper distance while talking and don’t touch [hands, shoulder, hug etc.] still some people take it otherwise and approach/follow us for their benefits. Hopefully there will be a time when people of India will become more understanding towards the actual help needed by a girl and not treat her as they wish.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P021
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: 8) Need to be alert all the time, just can't keep the guard down

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P022
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: It's a good thing to be alert but as girls, we have to be extremely cautious about our whereabouts or locality around new places. The moment people know girls are alone; their suspicious, criminal minds are elevated. Also, sometimes a casual conversation with locals, cab drivers, shopkeepers etc. may lead to queries about which hotel you are at? Or which place are you going next? It’s better to stay stern and have a (false) backup guesthouse in mind for those situations. As there was a case when a girl was spied, then raped and later murdered…. that’s the risk of revealing the location or sharing any personal story.

coded_segments.segment_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html_P023
coded_segments.source_id: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India.html
coded_segments.doc_title: Challenges faced by girls travelling alone in India
coded_segments.text: Even if we have many hurdles, we still step out every day. Girls have overcome some road blocks and I am glad to say India is definitely progressing and with amazing concept like Women only travel groups by Wander Womaniya, girls have been able to somewhat overcome the stigma of solo travelling. There have been few successful stories of girls travelling alone and we hope soon it will no more be alienated, instead appreciated and encouraged.
